title: Reading from the mushaf with all the rules: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Summer 1: Ash-Sharh, Ad-Duha 1 to 8 and applying the rules
source: Written for quran/y3 lesson 37 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Reading from the mushaf with all the rules rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 37. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

arabic.text: وَٱلتِّينِ وَٱلزَّيْتُونِ (١) وَطُورِ سِينِينَ (٢) وَهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ ٱلْأَمِينِ (٣) لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ فِىٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍۢ (٤) ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَٰهُ أَسْفَلَ سَٰفِلِينَ (٥) إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۢ (٦) فَمَا يُكَذِّبُكَ بَعْدُ بِٱلدِّينِ (٧) أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَحْكَمِ ٱلْحَٰكِمِينَ (٨)

head: Word
Where
Rule
rows: Qalqalah on د (in the middle of the ayah)
Ghunnah: meem with shaddah, two counts
Izhar: tanween before the throat letter غ
Izhar shafawi: meem sakinah before ء

keywords.def: hiding the noon with a light hum before certain letters

questions.q: Read 95:4 from the mushaf and name the rule on «ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ».
Reading turns: read At-Tin from the mushaf one ayah each. Then on the pupil PDF, mark the rules you used.
Extend: read Al-Qadr from the mushaf and find its ghunnah.
Stretch: find a madd you hold for 4 or 5 counts in At-Tin.
questions.a: «فِىٓ أَحْسَنِ» (95:4): a madd letter at the end of one word and a hamza at the start of the next (madd munfasil).

questions.q: Tanween before غ is read with ...
questions.a: A) izhar. غ is a throat letter: izhar.

questions.q: When reading from the mushaf, we look ...
Think again: Is it harder to apply the rules when reading from the mushaf than when reciting from memory? Why?
questions.a: Reading needs eyes and tongue together; we slow down and look one letter ahead.
